title: Selected Topics in Comparative Studies; Sufism: History, Literature, and Politics of Islamic Mysticism
description:
Cross-listed with PERS689T, PERS498T, HIST428Q, HIST638Q, and RELS419Q. Credit only granted for PERS498T, PERS689T, CMLT498T, HIST428Q, HIST638Q, or RELS419Q.

Provides an introduction to the history, literature, and politics of Sufism the Islamic "mystical" mode of piety from its origins to the modern period.
